messages:
deploybot: STARTED pipeline for release v1.12.0 -> staging (commit ab12c3d, tag v1.12.0). job: build/test/lint. window: change-window-2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 UTC.
ci-bot: Build started on runner gpu-large-3. logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/7890
alice: seeing the integration suite failing early, marking :eyes:. any idea what changed in deps?
ben: quick glance at commit shows bump to `protobuf` to 4.24.0 in third_party. could be related.
lisa: if it's a proto break, we should NOT ship in this window. recommend hold and triage.
sam: can we rerun just the failing integration matrix with `--seed=42` and `--retry-flaky`? might be flake but let's validate.
ci-bot: Integration job failed: 1/12 tests failed. Summary:
```
FAIL tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py::TestKVCache::test_reconnect_on_node_drop - AssertionError: expected 42, got 41
Stack: /workspace/service/kv/cache.py:213
Command: pytest -k test_reconnect_on_node_drop -q --durations=10
```
ci-bot: Related logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/7890/logs/integration-3
alice: that's deterministic in local repro for me. repro steps pasted in thread.
ben: +1 to hold. also we have an ongoing Dedicated customer deploy next week; let's not change runtime behavior mid-window.
oncall: if triage can't produce a fix in 30m we should rollback the commit and rerun. ping me at +1 when 20m left. :alarm_clock:
deplybot: rerun triggered by @sam for integration matrix (retry-flaky).
ci-bot: RERUN started (job 7890-2).
ci-bot: RERUN finished — FAILED (same test).
alice: repro stack points at a race in replica eviction timing after the protobuf bump. I'm going to open a minimal PR to revert the bump and run unit tests.
ben: if revert fixes unit tests we can pin the dependency on the release branch and proceed with the window. pin vs full rollback: pin is lower blast radius.
lisa: ops question: if we pin on release branch, do we still meet canary SLA? we need 10% canary for 30m.
oncall: decision criteria: pin on release branch allowed only if test-fix verified in CI within window and no customer-facing regressions in canary. otherwise rollback and reschedule.
alice: created PR #4321: revert protobuf bump to 4.23.4. CI started. https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4321
ci-bot: PR #4321 CI: build ✅, unit tests ✅, integration subset ✅. Full integration matrix queued.
ci-bot: Full integration matrix ✅. All tests passed.
sam: given green CI, propose applying pin to release branch (cherry-pick commit def123 onto release/v1.12) and then re-trigger staging deploy.
ben: also add a short note in release notes: "pin protobuf to 4.23.4 due to integration regression".
lisa: ops approves canary at 10% for 30m once pin is deployed. please coordinate with customer-success if any dedicated customers are affected.
oncall: keeping watch. if any post-deploy errors >5% in error budget within canary window, we rollback.
deplybot: APPLY PATCH: cherry-pick def123 -> release/v1.12 (user: sam). Patch applied.
deplybot: PIPELINE re-triggered for staging (commit tag v1.12.0-rc1-pin).
ci-bot: New pipeline job 7891: build/test/lint started.
ci-bot: Lint ✅, Build ✅, Unit tests ✅, Integration ✅.
deplybot: DEPLOY started to staging canary (10%). commit: def123 (tag v1.12.0-rc1-pin). environment: staging. ETA ~3m.
alice: monitoring logs for KV errors.
ci-bot: Canary smoke checks passed. latency OK. no increase in error-rate.
lisa: OK to proceed with full staging rollout.
oncall: still watching — will give :thumbsup: after 30m canary.
ben: drafting the release notes now, will include the pin and note about the revert and that we'll run a postmortem on the proto bump.
deplybot: DEPLOY finished to staging (100%). all checks green.
alice: quick post-deploy sanity run ✅. no regressions locally.
sam: moving to schedule prod rollout in next change window (2026-03-21 02:00 UTC). will open change request.
lisa: thanks team. good coordination. :tada:
